components.name: Primary Connection Button
components.description: Starts a provider connection or sign-in prerequisite.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 15px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: #1f7356; color: #f5fff9; font: 690 13px var(--font-geist, sans-serif); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #15513d; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #5bc49a; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Disabled Secondary Button
components.description: Shows an unavailable action without hiding its dependency.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 15px; border: 1px solid #d1d8d3; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; color: #26332c; font: 690 13px var(--font-geist, sans-serif); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #f4f6f3; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #5bc49a; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation Item
components.description: The default, hover, and active language of desktop navigation.
components.html: OverviewCalendar
components.css: .ds-nav { width: 216px; padding: 12px; background: #18201c; display: grid; gap: 5px; } .ds-nav-item { height: 46px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 12px; color: #aeb9b3; display: flex; align-items: center; text-decoration: none; font: 620 14px var(--font-geist, sans-serif); } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #243029; color: #f3f7f4; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #5bc49a; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-nav-active { background: #f3f7f4; color: #18201c; }

components.name: Preview Status Chip
components.description: Names non-live data directly in a quiet utility style.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; padding: 7px 9px; border-radius: 9px; background: #edf2ee; color: #526159; font: 600 11px var(--font-geist, sans-serif); }

components.name: Agenda Event
components.description: A compact appointment block with explicit source and duration.
components.css: .ds-event { padding: 15px 16px; border-radius: 13px; background: #edf5f0; color: #18201c; display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; font-family: var(--font-geist, sans-serif); } .ds-event h3 { margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 15px; } .ds-event p { margin: 0; color: #617068; font-size: 12px; } .ds-event p span { margin-left: 8px; color: #1f7356; } .ds-event small { color: #607068; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Channel Selection Row
components.description: A selectable provider row with explicit disconnected state.
components.css: .ds-channel { width: 100%; min-height: 104px; padding: 18px 24px; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid #e2e7e3; background: #edf5f0; color: #18201c; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 44px minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap: 14px; align-items: center; text-align: left; font-family: var(--font-geist, sans-serif); } .ds-channel:hover { background: #e6f2eb; } .ds-channel:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #5bc49a; outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-channel-icon { width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 13px; background: #e8efea; color: #1f7356; display: grid; place-items: center; font-weight: 700; } .ds-channel b, .ds-channel small { display: block; } .ds-channel b { font-size: 15px; } .ds-channel small { margin-top: 5px; color: #68736d; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-channel em { padding: 7px 10px; border-radius: 9px; background: #f3ede8; color: #7b6556; font: normal 12px var(--font-geist, sans-serif); }

components.name: Setup Warning
components.description: Explains incomplete provider setup and the recovery action.
components.html:
Connection setup is not complete

Add the OAuth URL and provider credentials, then try again.

narrative.overview:
AI FLOW feels like a focused operations desk: a stable dark frame holds a quiet, cool workspace where account state, appointments, and required actions are easy to scan. The system is practical and restrained rather than decorative, using hierarchy, spacing, and explicit language to make operational truth visible.

The interface is dense enough for daily work without feeling cramped. Large, tightly set page titles orient the user; white panels organize task content; the emerald accent appears only where it signals a useful action, keyboard focus, or healthy state. Unconfigured and preview states are named honestly instead of being disguised as live data.
keyCharacteristics: Dark charcoal navigation frame with a cool neutral workspace.
Restrained emerald action and status language.
Rounded, compact controls and calm white panels.
Explicit preview, disabled, protected, and unconfigured states.
Task-first responsive composition with persistent mobile navigation.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Emerald is the only interactive accent; reserve it for action, focus, availability, or confirmed health.

rules.name: The Honest State Rule
rules.body: Warning amber communicates incomplete setup, while neutral copy states “Not connected,” “Preview data,” or disabled status explicitly; color never carries status alone.

rules.name: The Scan First Rule
rules.body: Lead with short headings and state labels; explanatory copy follows in quieter type and remains concise.

rules.name: The Flat Frame Rule
rules.body: Never shadow the sidebar, top bar, date rail, banners, or bottom navigation; their depth comes from tonal contrast and borders.

dos: Do keep the charcoal navigation frame stable while task content changes inside the cool neutral workspace.
Do use emerald sparingly for primary action, focus, confirmed health, and availability.
Do name preview, disconnected, protected, disabled, and incomplete-setup states in visible text.
Do preserve agenda-first and selection-first order when columns stack on smaller screens.
Do use 12–16px radii for controls and panels, with compact 9px badges where appropriate.
donts: Don't use multiple competing accent colors or decorative gradients.
Don't present preview appointments or unconfigured providers as live customer data.
Don't hide required recovery actions behind color, icons, tooltips, or provider jargon.
Don't add shadows to every surface; depth is mostly tonal and structural.
Don't replace visible keyboard focus with subtle border changes.
